snippet.title: Death In Abyss - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Get it on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2076520/Death_In_Abyss/

Death In Abyss is an intense flight shooter that challenges you to utilize your maneuverability and explosive firepower to survive against the deep-sea hostilities. In your descent, the nightmares can only get worse. 

The game blends elements from classics like Star Fox 64, Devil Daggers, and Omega Boost into a difficult action-horror experience.

Patreon: https://patreon.com/agelvik
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/DEseUGr
Twitter: https://twitter.com/Agelvik
More games: https://store.steampowered.com/developer/agelvik
----
